_about: The two safety modes' table (LIBRARY_DESIGN.md 13.6; ROADMAP product track P3). 'engines': per engine, the optimizations it declares do not change results, the engine option that turns each off and the value that does, with where the engine says so. 'candidates': which optimizations a disagreement between two of the engine's own paths points at (path_contract's pairs), in the order the selective safe path tries them - one per start.
